summary: 43 units reviewed. 13 errors (mainly the Book 4 glossary rendering daṇḍa = penalty, not fine; bare uttama/madhyama unsupplied; दण्ड-पारुष्य in Hindi; wrong gram on pratyāsarat), 19 minor (added 'or' in compound lists, small Hindi additions, gram labels, a guessed sense in notes). No regrouping needed. No new text_flags needed; word splits and tokens are sound. Doubts for a person: 8/9 dadyāt as 'make good'; 20/21 pravāsayata/pravāsane (sends away vs killing); 22 cakra-yuktam, pratyāsarat; 23 abhyāvahet (subject, 'make good' vs 'impose'); 28 kāmam and whole verse; 41 anātmanaḥ; 21 adāne could be a typo for ādāne; 14 list structure.
